operations.description: Create a new Core ASK and either save it as a draft or submit it for review, based on buttonValue. Exit makes no change.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID to ensure idempotent processing of retry requests

responses.description: Core ASK created successfully with Save & Exit or SUBMIT
Validation failed - missing required field, inactive reference ID, or constraint violation
Forbidden - caller lacks Create New ASK permission
Conflict - duplicate Idempotency-Key with different request body
Service unavailable - reference data, employee, or attachment service down

schemas.name: CreateCoreAskRequest
schemas.description: Request body for creating a new Core ASK

fields.name: coreAskDetails
fields.description: Core ASK business data

fields.name: coreAskDetails.coreAskName
fields.description: Name of the Core ASK

fields.name: coreAskDetails.dppGroupId
fields.description: DPP Group identifier - must be active

fields.name: coreAskDetails.needReasonId
fields.description: Need reason identifier - must be active

fields.name: coreAskDetails.generalSpecialityNeedId
fields.description: General/Specialty need identifier - must be active

fields.name: coreAskDetails.generalSpecialityNeedComment

constraints.conditionallyRequired: Required unless generalSpecialityNeedId is the first option

fields.description: Comment for general/specialty need - required unless first option selected

fields.name: coreAskDetails.levelNeedId
fields.description: Level need identifier - must be active

fields.name: coreAskDetails.pml
fields.description: PML field - optional, new-version only

fields.name: coreAskDetails.projectedStartDate
fields.description: Projected start date in ISO 8601 format

fields.name: coreAskDetails.endDate
fields.description: End date in ISO 8601 format - must be after projectedStartDate and not before today

fields.name: coreAskDetails.outgoingResource
fields.description: Outgoing resource name - derived from employeeId, read-only

fields.name: coreAskDetails.employeeId
fields.description: Employee identifier - must be valid

fields.name: coreAskDetails.headCountAmount
fields.description: Headcount amount - must be positive

fields.name: coreAskDetails.fteAmount
fields.description: FTE amount - must not exceed headCountAmount

fields.name: coreAskDetails.rolePostingId

constraints.conditionallyRequired: Required when levelNeedId is in the top-3 set

fields.description: Role posting identifier - required for top-3 levels, must be active

fields.name: coreAskDetails.numberofresources
fields.description: Number of resources

fields.name: coreAskDetails.titlingCategory
fields.description: Titling category - required, new-version only

fields.name: coreAskDetails.transitionalCoach
fields.description: Transitional coach - optional, new-version only

fields.name: coreAskDetails.roleSummary
fields.description: Role summary - required

fields.name: coreAskDetails.roleResponsibility
fields.description: Role responsibility - required

fields.name: coreAskDetails.roleQualification
fields.description: Role qualification - required

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Optional comment text

fields.name: documents
fields.description: Optional array of document attachments

fields.name: buttonValue
fields.description: Action button value - controls save/submit/exit behavior

schemas.name: CreateCoreAskResponse
schemas.description: Response body for successfully created Core ASK

fields.name: askId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the created ASK

fields.name: askDetailId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ASK detail record

fields.name: coreAskDetails
fields.description: Echo of the created Core ASK business data

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version number - always 1 for new ASK

fields.name: task
fields.description: Created workflow task information

fields.name: task.taskId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the created task

fields.name: task.statusId
fields.description: Workflow status ID - 123 In Progress, 127 PPL Review, or 145 DPP Ops Review

fields.name: task.assigneeId
fields.description: Identifier of the assigned user or group

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Created comment information - present only if comment was provided

fields.name: comment.commentId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the created comment

fields.name: auditHistory
fields.description: Audit history record for the creation event

fields.name: auditHistory.auditId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit history record

schemas.name: ProblemDetails
schemas.description: RFC 7807 problem response, as emitted by ASP.NET Core

fields.name: type
fields.description: URI identifying the problem type

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short, human-readable summary - stable for a given type

fields.name: status
fields.description: HTTP status code

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence

fields.name: instance
fields.description: The request path this occurred on

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable DRT error code - safe for clients to branch on

fields.name: traceId
fields.description: W3C trace identifier for the request

fields.name: errors
fields.description: Field-level validation failures - present on 400 and 422 only

openPoints.item: Status ID to name mapping: 123, 127, 145 — exact named-state equivalents not confirmed in any approved source
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - numeric IDs travel in the contract as integers per settled decision. The ID-to-name mapping is reference data, not contract surface.

openPoints.item: 'Top-3 set' for levelNeedId referenced in BR17 — specific reference data IDs not defined
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - validation logic is server-side. Contract defines the field and conditional requirement.

openPoints.item: 'First option' ID for needReasonId (BR6) and generalSpecialityNeedId (BR7) — specific reference data IDs not defined
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - validation logic is server-side. Contract defines the fields and conditional requirements.

openPoints.item: 'Retirement' value for needReasonId referenced in BR11 — specific reference data ID not defined
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - validation logic is server-side. Contract defines the field and conditional requirement.

openPoints.item: Leadership group membership rule and attribute source used for routing decision (BR24, BR25, AC2, AC3) — not present in RBAC matrix reference
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - routing is server-side behaviour with no contract surface. Response returns whichever statusId resulted.

openPoints.item: Exact permission code for 'Create New ASK' — permission name not specified in spec or RBAC matrix reference
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - authorization enforcement is server-side per SEC 002. Contract defines 403 response for insufficient permission.

openPoints.item: Success HTTP status code — spec states 200 or 201 but does not confirm which applies for a create operation
openPoints.resolution: Resolved: 201 Created per DRT API Design Standards section 6. Exit button returns 200 with no body change per settled decision.

openPoints.item: Idempotency key requirement and scope for the create command — not specified in spec
openPoints.resolution: Resolved: Idempotency-Key header required per DRT API Design Standards section 6 and REL 001.

openPoints.item: Transaction scope across Ask, Task, Comment, Audit, and Attachment entities — explicitly unconfirmed in spec (Assumption 1)
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - transaction behaviour is implementation detail. Contract defines atomic success or failure through response codes.

openPoints.item: 'New-version only' field semantics for pml, titlingCategory, transitionalCoach (BR9, BR18, BR19) — not clarified whether this create operation is the new version context
openPoints.resolution: Not blocking - fields are included in the contract per the design card. Semantic interpretation is implementation detail.
